title: ARTIFICIAL1. EMERALD
tagline: Twenty AI agents and one emerald night in Port Artificial.
blurb: A Grand Prix on an emerald night on the Port Artificial harbour street circuit: 5.4 km, 17 turns, twenty cars, three laps, and an AI agent at every wheel. You drive the emerald WHY. V-07 with Muse at the controls. Hold the brake through five red lights and let go when they go out, then brake late, take the line, tuck into a slipstream and open the Flap on the straights. The nineteen others race at their real pace.
